messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: high org QPS spike detected for org_id=org-9283 (ZenithCo). 10-min avg QPS = 1.2k (baseline 90). Error rate (429) increased from 0.1% -> 18% across shared pool. Auto-throttle tripped for several routes. Notifying on-call.

maya (oncall): acked, i'm on it. paging harper and runtime. tagging @zenith-support so they're aware.

harper (sre): reading graphs now. Is this isolated to a single org? looks like org-9283 is the primary contributor. can we confirm which routes?

eli (eng-runtime): logs show a huge number of short context requests to /v1/generate-chat and lots of repeated params. sample: `org-9283 -> /v1/generate-chat?model=fast-lite` with many retried requests. 429s originate at the per-org RL gate.

maya (oncall): proposal: emergency, org-scoped mitigation. two options: 1) temporary per-org QPS increase (surgically bump quota) while we contact customer and investigate; 2) enforce stricter burst smoothing (lower burst) + shed low-priority feature flags. prefer #1 short-term. thoughts?

harper (sre): agree. quick bump to reduce collateral 429s for other orgs. but limit TTL and monitor closely. set a 20 minute window and a follow-up rollback.

eli (eng-runtime): ready to run admin command. I'll push the change and monitor metrics. executing now:

```
# run by eli at 2026-03-15T21:20:12Z
adminctl org adjust-rate --org org-9283 --qps 400 --burst 1200 --ttl 1200 --reason "rapid-qps-surgery: temporary bump to cut collateral 429s"
```

deploy-bot: CHANGELOG: org-rate-update org-9283 by eli; change_id=chg-7f4a1; audit=true.

maya (oncall): copy. watching dashboards. zen-support, do you have the customer on the line / any known changes?

zenith-support: Zenith engineering says they pushed a batch job this morning that fan-outs some internal calls; they did not expect this magnitude. they are investigating and will throttle their side. thanks for the quick action.

harper (sre): seeing immediate improvement — 429s dropping from 18% -> 3% in 2m. latency also normalizing. good call.

eli (eng-runtime): added an extra soft-shed rule for non-critical routes from org-9283 as a precaution (weight=0.2). command: `adminctl org add-shed-rule --org org-9283 --route "/embeddings*" --weight 0.2`

maya (oncall): starting incident timeline note: 21:20 alert, 21:23 bump applied, 21:25 429s down to 3%, 21:30 monitoring stable. setting incident severity: sev2.

harper (sre): quick root-cause hypothesis: customer job has exponential retry on 5xx which amplified requests. request we open a postmortem and ensure we add an org-specific runaway detector for repeated identical small requests (fingerprint + rate limiter).

eli (eng-runtime): agree; also proposing a short-lived per-org circuit-breaker: if identical request signature > 500 rps for 60s then auto-soft-throttle. I'll file a ticket.

maya (oncall): handoff in 30m to tess (night-oncall). will leave temporary bump TTL at 20m (auto rollback at 21:43). tess — please monitor and confirm rollback success; contact harper if anything spikes.

tess (night-oncall): acked, i'll take over at 21:50.

zenith-support: we will pause the batch and roll a fix to backoff/retry logic. ETA 40m. appreciate the temporary lift.

harper (sre): note — we should capture token-level cost impact and ask acct team about a potential billing adjustment for the temporary bump. added to actions.

maya (oncall): automated rollback executed at TTL=1200s (21:43):

```
# auto-rollback log
deploy-bot: REVERT: change_id=chg-7f4a1; result=success; reverted_by=system; ts=2026-03-15T21:43:35Z
```

harper (sre): post-rollback metrics: 429s edged up to 5% but still far better than 18%. zen has paused job so traffic is back to baseline.

eli (eng-runtime): creating follow-up tickets:
- SRE: add org-runaway detector (priority P1)
- Runtime: implement auto soft-circuit for repeated identical small requests (P1)
- Support: reach out to Zenith for RCA and potential billing note (P2)

maya (oncall): summary for incident notes:
- impact: org-9283 caused widespread 429s for shared pool customers; customer-facing errors observed.
- mitigation: temporary org-specific QPS bump + shed rules. auto-rollback after 20m.
- status: resolved, monitoring.

harper (sre): adding postmortem owner: harper. will coordinate with zen-support and eng-runtime.

maya (oncall): handing off to tess now for overnight watch. closing this thread unless more issues. thanks everyone. :tada:

tess (night-oncall): confirmed stable at 22:05. I'll keep an eye and escalate if it reappears.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: incident_id=inc-2026-03-15-9283; severity=sev2; duration=00:45:32; owner=harper; followups=[org-runaway-detector, runtime-circuit-breaker, customer-rca].
